definition.name: Compile exact standard WASI backend and bounded resource controls

steps.name: Check source ownership, original whole WIT and private bridge guards
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
python3 -B -m unittest tools.tests.test_rust_wasi_http_profile tools.tests.test_rust_wasi_http_inputs_prepared -v

steps.name: Execute only the actual bounded options and fields implementation controls
Acquire only locked SDK compiler sources before offline compilation
Compile and authenticate only the selected WASI backend
Retain bounded compiler observations without build cache or signer credentials

with.name: rust-wasi-http-backend-${{ github.sha }}
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-http-resource-controls.txt
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-http-runtime/INSTALL-COMPLETE.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-http-runtime/INSTALL-FAILED.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-http-runtime/source-inputs.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-http-runtime/reference.wit.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-http-runtime/adapter.wit.json
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-http-runtime/raw-runtime.wasm
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-http-runtime/rust-wasi-http-runtime.wasm
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-http-runtime/logs/*.stdout.txt
${{ runner.temp }}/rust-http-runtime/logs/*.stderr.txt

reviewReason: One locked offline Wasm backend compile after explicit pinned SDK dependency fetch,16 Python and11 actual-source resource controls; bounded public evidence only, no native host or signed application build.
